name: What should I do immediately if I suspect a gas leak?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if I suspect a gas leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you suspect a gas leak, prioritize safety. First, evacuate everyone from the building immediately, including pets. Do not use anything that could create a spark, such as light switches, cell phones, or any electrical appliances. Do not try to locate the leak yourself or operate any gas valves. Once safely outside and away from the building, call your gas utility company's emergency line or 911 from a safe location. They will dispatch professionals to assess and address the situation. After the gas company has made it safe, you can then contact a qualified plumber for repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Evacuate immediately, do not use anything that could spark, and from a safe distance, call your gas utility company's emergency line or 911.
